goal: Implement the evidence-based production hardening audit (2026-10-06) across Digital-ocean-bot, preserving current operator configuration and owned-resource safety. Fix sticky verified admission/output; truthful health/account status; bounded fair recovery; bounded provisioning; failure circuit by account/region/image; faster durable client queue; process FD and actual Xray health; retention/pool bounds. Treat optional surge and client failover as explicit capability gaps: never violate Desired/provider capacity, fake migration of TCP sessions, or bypass proxy/host-key/mutation gates.
context: Baseline bc3651e, runtime5628300, schema158. No product source dirty. Read-only audit evidence /root/backups/dob-audit-20261006. 2 owned Vultr guests reject matching API-verified key; a panel was stale20h. Guardian rejects new TCP but no client migration; last blocked state must persist across failed reads and disable intent until cleanup receipt. Main already runs lifecycle separately: preserve that, avoid duplicate worker. User authorized fixes throughout project and deploy with rollback. API planning/review only; implementation done by interactive agent. Need full Go, race and isolated PostgreSQL fault regression tests and bounded rollout. Preserve external operator settings and primary/failover identities. No claim of universal zero downtime.
commit_message: fix: harden fleet admission, recovery, and service health
